heroHeadline: Day 614: Olinia EV Unveiled as Mexico's First Domestic Electric Car; CNTE Strike Day 7 as SEGOB Exhorts End of Zócalo Sit-In; OECD Cuts Mexico 2026 Growth to 0.8%; World Cup Opener in 4 Days
heroSubtitle: June 7, 2026 marks Day 614 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency — a weekend of mounting pressure ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026 opener (Mexico vs. South Africa, Estadio Azteca, June 11). On June 7, Mexico's first domestically designed electric vehicle — the Olinia ('to move' in Nahuatl) — was officially unveiled; three versions (cargo, personal, taxi) priced at 90,000–150,000 pesos; mass production of 20,000 units/year slated for 2027 under Plan México's industrial policy. Interior Ministry (SEGOB) Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez formally exhorted the CNTE to conclude its Zócalo encampment after SEP and ISSSTE submitted written proposals on the two core demands; the CNTE rejected them as insufficient (2007 ISSSTE law left intact) and threatened airport and Estadio Azteca blockades during the June 11 opener — the strike's seventh consecutive day affecting 2+ million students across 29 states. On June 6 (Day 613), Sheinbaum led the Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro national assembly in Xalapa, Veracruz, highlighting 3.5 million beneficiaries and 170 billion pesos invested since 2019. Key economic developments: OECD published its June 2026 Economic Outlook on June 3, cutting Mexico's 2026 GDP forecast to 0.8% (down from 1.3%), now the most pessimistic major forecast ahead of Citi (1.1%) and IMF (1.6%); OECD cited Q1's -0.8% QoQ contraction, U.S. tariff drag, fiscal consolidation, and policy uncertainty. On USMCA: Bloomberg and Claims Journal report that the US, Mexico, and Canada are on track to miss the July 1 formal 16-year renewal deadline — a provisional framework is the most probable outcome; Round 2 is scheduled June 16–17 in Washington. Five days ago: Sheinbaum held the mañanera from Minatitlán, Veracruz (June 5), launching a 93-billion-peso petrochemical investment plan and announcing the Mahahual ecotourism protection decree (World Environment Day).
